# Friendly Calculator

> Friendly Calculator is an independent website offering free online calculators and plain-language guides for finance, tax, salary, business, mathematics and everyday calculations. The primary audience includes people in India, with multilingual pages for additional audiences.

## Official website
- https://friendlycalculator.in/
- https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/about.html
- https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/contact.html
- https://friendlycalculator.in/blog/
- https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/site-directory.html
- https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/methodology.html
- https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/disclaimer.html

## Editorial and calculation notes
- Calculator outputs are estimates based on user-entered values, formulas and stated assumptions; they are not guarantees or professional advice.
- Readers should check each calculator's method, limitations and relevant official sources before relying on important results.
- The blog contains explanatory guides and calculator education. It should not be treated as a real-time news wire.
- Public contact and publisher information is available on the About and Contact pages.
